title: CI Executive Build Health
subtitle: Leadership view of CI build volume, success rate, build speed and engineering time spent in CI, with period-over-period comparison.

widget.title: Build Success Rate

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| aggregate { round(100.0 * count(case when pe.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as success_rate }

widget.subtitle: Share of CI executions that finished SUCCESS

widget.title: Total Builds

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| aggregate { count() as total_builds }

widget.subtitle: CI pipeline executions vs previous period

widget.title: Builds per Day
widget.subtitle: Average builds on days with CI activity

widget.title: Median Build Duration
widget.subtitle: Typical end-to-end build time (lower is better)

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| aggregate { distinct_count(pe.pipelineidentifier) as active_pipelines }

widget.title: Engineering Hours in CI

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| aggregate { round(sum(pe.build_duration) / 3600000.0, 1) as ci_hours }

widget.subtitle: Total wall-clock build hours across all executions

widget.subtitle: Build volume per week, stacked by final status

widget.title: Weekly Success Rate
widget.subtitle: Percent of builds succeeding each week

widget.title: Weekly Engineering Hours in CI
widget.subtitle: Wall-clock hours spent building per week

widget.title: Top Projects by Build Volume
widget.subtitle: Projects running the most CI builds

widget.title: Project Build Scorecard

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
    pe.orgidentifier as organization,
    pe.projectidentifier as project,
    count() as builds,
    round(100.0 * count(case when pe.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as success_rate_pct,
    distinct_count(pe.pipelineidentifier) as pipelines,
    round(median(pe.build_duration) / 60000.0, 1) as median_minutes,
    round(sum(pe.build_duration) / 3600000.0, 1) as ci_hours
  }
| group_by organization, project
| order_by builds desc
| limit 25

widget.subtitle: Volume, reliability, speed and CI time per project
